title: P1 file.get: request
description: Reading the bytes of a file under the lease of a delivery, call or attempt. The file is returned only if it belongs to the tenant of the work and its mark is not above what the recipient is allowed; otherwise not_found (TEN-7, PRM-9). The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).
